title: Pooh Shiesty’s ‘All Eyes on Shiest’ Debuts at No. 1 on Top R&B/Hip-Hop Albums Chart
summary: Fourteen cuts make the Hot R&B/Hip-Hop Songs chart as the rapper awaits federal trial.
contentText:
Pooh Shiesty is the main attraction on Billboard ’s Top R&B/Hip-Hop Albums chart as he scores his first No. 1 with the LP All Eyes on Shiest debuts at No. 1 on the list dated Aug. 22. The album, released on 1017/Atlantic Records, starts with 51,000 equivalent album units in the United States for the tracking week of Aug. 7-13, according to Luminate. Through its performance, 14 of the set’s tracks appear on the Hot R&B/Hip-Hop Songs , the most of any artist this week.

Of the album’s first-week total, streaming activity contributes 49,500 units, a figure equal to 51.6 million official on-demand streams of the album’s songs. One thousand five hundred units derive from traditional album sales, and a negligible amount of activity comes from track-equivalent album sales. (One unit equals the following levels of consumption: one album sale, 10 individual tracks sold from an album, or 1,000 paid/subscription tier or 2,500 ad-supported tier of official on-demand audio and video streams for a song on the album.)

The album gives Pooh Shiesty his first No. 1 on Top R&B/Hip-Hop Albums with his second appearance. 2021’s Shiesty Season mixtape debuted and peaked at No. 2. Elsewhere, All Eyes on Shiest opens at No. 1 on Top Rap Albums — his second leader, after Shiesty Season — and No. 7 on the all-genre Billboard 200 , his second top 10 there.

All Eyes on Shiest arrives as the rapper is the centerpiece of a federal trial , scheduled for February 2027, over allegations that he and multiple co-conspirators forced Gucci Mane at gunpoint to release him from his record deal. Pooh Shiesty has pleaded not guilty.

Adding to the kickoff, 14 of the album’s tracks land on the 50-position Hot R&B/Hip-Hop Songs chart, led by debuts for “Last Man Breathin” (No. 11) and “Reap What You Sew” (No. 13). The tracks enter at Nos. 7 and 9, respectively, on Hot Rap Songs , becoming his fourth and fifth top 10s on the ranking.

Here’s a review of the All Eyes on Shiest placements on Hot R&B/Hip-Hop Songs this week. Notably, previous release “FDO,” though absent from this week’s chart, debuted at No. 1 on the chart dated Dec. 27, 2025, securing the rapper’s first champ on the chart.
